fact: ANSUT's RNHD infrastructure director states the RNHD totals more than 6,600 km of optical fibre across the country.
The article says ANSUT had completed 5,476 km of fibre and 66 cut points of its planned 7,000 km national high-speed backbone (RNHD) in 2023.
The article says 2,245 km of the ANSUT backbone is operated by Orange CI, MTN CI and Moov Africa CI.
